text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
It's finally here: Dad and Mom's date. I 
hope they enjoy the plan we made for them.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Onee-san gave me the museum tickets. I'll 
arrange for the limousine...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally ready too~~! A restaurant with 
a super pretty night view!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Made sure to book it... wait, huh? ...The 
reservation didn't go through...?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
No way, I messed up!? Wh-What do I 
dooooo!?!?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Calm down, Vivlos. We can just come up 
with another idea.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
An alternative plan... Maybe having them 
enjoy dinner and the night view at my 
place? But the view from my apartment 
might not set enough of a mood—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Come to think of it... didn't we have 
a home projector at our place...?"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
That's it! Then it's Vivlos's turn to 
shine! Could you prepare the footage of 
that special night view? I'll arrange the 
catering.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Big sis, Cheval-chi...! Wahhh, thank you 
so much, you guys~~~~!!!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
N-Not really... I just happened to 
remember, is all...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, looks like this is gonna work out 
great! Alright, let's nail down the 
details. The three of us are gonna give 
our papas the time of their lives!
